question: Does the temporal-Q8 projection of the selective is/was cDAS write carry selective held-out is/was behavior, and does it compose exactly with the task-specific remainder?

frozen_intervention.population: Exactly the original cDAS held-out groups: v2 A1 rows 8+, all v2 A2, v2 P/C rows 8+, and all v3 A1/A2/P/C.
frozen_intervention.write_decomposition: For each donor-base resid18 delta d and released normalized cDAS axis a, original write w=(d^T a)a. Let p=SS^T a for the frozen temporal-Q8 residual projector S and c=a-p. Install w_shared=(d^T a)p and w_specific=(d^T a)c. Their sum must equal w exactly; neither component is renormalized or refit.
frozen_intervention.selectivity: A1/A2 use donor answer/foil recovery. P/C retain the original same-answer absolute effect divided by the frozen cDAS target scale 1.9129114151000977.

predictions.pred_a_exact_authority_replay_decomposit: Original cDAS reproduces its released family metrics within 1e-4; shared+specific matches original logits within 1e-5; write closure is within 1e-6; coverage and price are exact.
predictions.pred_b_temporal_q8_shared_component_is_c: Shared write has positive mean recovery and at least 0.10 mean absolute recovery in all four held-out A families, with donorward direction on at least 75% of rows per family.
predictions.pred_c_temporal_q8_shared_component_is_s: Shared P/C same-answer effects are at most 0.20 in all four held-out control families.
predictions.pred_d_iswas_specific_component_remains_: Specific write has at least 0.25 mean absolute recovery in all four A families.
predictions.pred_e_shared_and_specific_compose_witho: Shared plus specific equals original, and both components have positive signed mean recovery in every A family.

decision: Promote shared causal reuse only if all five gates pass. A selective but weak shared arm remains geometric overlap; a strong but nonselective shared arm is readout-aligned nuisance. Either null blocks the finite cross-task Hankel claim for this axis.
